description: Learner labels for how a verb or adjective is inflected. For each verb/adjective token, the analyzer reads its own conjugation form, then the auxiliaries (and the particles て/で/ば) directly after it, in order: 食べ+なかっ+た = negative, past. The first rule whose fields all match a token gives its label (surface exact, base = orthographic base or lemma, form = conjugation-form prefix). Shared rule data for the Python analyzer and a browser engine. A follower rule may name its own pos; a token matching such a rule also continues the word (高く + adjective ない = negative).
